messages:
alex.csm: Quick heads-up — Saffron QBR is next Tue 3pm PT. Need a concise cost slide: current burn, 3 forecast scenarios (flat, +20%, +50%), token econ breakdown (embed vs gen), and any alerts we surfaced. Spreadsheet here: https://redwood.app/saffron-qbr (please don't break links)

maria.am: Thanks Alex. I'll own the renewal ask / product enablement bullets. Can you drop the latest 30d token counts and top-3 endpoints?

alex.csm: Dropping what I have inline: 30d tokens: 2.1M gen, 4.8M embeddings. Top endpoints: /search-embed, /chat-assist, /docs-qa. I put a starter tab in the sheet labeled "CSM inputs" — please add any upsell asks.

jordan.finops: Got it. I'll run the spend forecast. Quick question: do we want cost modeled with quantization/caching assumptions? e.g. cached prefix for /search-embed reduces tokens by ~18% historically.

alex.csm: Yes include a cached vs uncached column. Also add a column for proposed quota guardrail (monthly cap) and a note if they'd need burst capacity for marketing week.

ryan.ops: I can schedule the enablement session with Saffron on Mon 10am PT if that works. Who should present token optimization best practices?

maria.am: I'll present enablement. Jordan — can you prepare one slide showing where they save vs baseline (batching, KV cache, model switch)? Keep it high level.

jordan.finops: Sure — will prepare a simple table and a short calc. Provisional numbers: baseline p50 latency cost = $0.00095/token gen, embeddings = $0.00012/token. With batching & quantized 4-bit model, gen per-token cost drops ~35%. I'll put exact rows in the sheet.

billing-bot: [auto] Invoice alert: Customer Saffron - upcoming invoice due in 7 days. No outstanding disputes.

alex.csm: Good to know — add a short note on renewal ask: 12-month commit vs month-to-month. Maria, flag if we should recommend a reserved tier during QBR.

maria.am: Recommend proposing a committed tier with a trial burst for the upcoming marketing spike. I'll draft the slide and add a suggested pricing blurb in the doc.

jordan.finops: Added a 'Spend Scenarios' tab with the three growth cases and a simple monte-carlo row for variance. Also added a small calc showing token mix shift impact (more embeddings => lower unit cost overall).

alex.csm: Perfect. Two last asks: 1) annotate any open enablement tickets on the sheet under 'blockers' 2) everyone drop final edits by Friday EOD so I can stitch the deck.

ryan.ops: Blockers noted. I'll confirm Mon session invite and wire up the calendar invite after edits are final.

maria.am: Will finalize enablement bullets and renewal recommendation by Friday EOD.

jordan.finops: Finalizing cost slide now, will ping when done.

alex.csm: Thanks team :thumbsup: — we'll run a 20-min dry run Fri 11am PT. Please RSVP on the doc.
